design.rationale: API + auth-chokepoint + key-lifecycle design re-read against running evidence: node --test is 38/38 green (14 core + 24 HTTP) and live curl confirmed 401/403/404 denial and rotate changing the stored hash — accepted.

infrastructure.rationale: node:http server, ephemeral-port tests, zero deps, atomic data.json persistence (HASHES ONLY) re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

security.rationale: raw keys NEVER stored (sha256-only at rest), shown once at issue/rotate, redacted from all logs; deny-by-default isolation via core.owned(); constant-time token compare; env-injected secrets re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green, live curl confirmed 401/403/404 and rotate-changes-hash, and a live-run scan found zero raw-key occurrences in data.json or logs — accepted.

ux_ui.rationale: accessible keys console renders metadata + last4, reveals the raw key exactly once (role=alert), never shows foreign data; accessible forms/live regions re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green — accepted.

performance.rationale: in-memory per-tenant Map store; crypto mint + sha256 on issue/rotate; sub-ms request handling observed in structured logs re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green — accepted.

features.rationale: tenant-scoped key lifecycle (issue/list/get/rotate/revoke) + verify-by-hash + audit + DSAR erase over HTTP re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green and live curl confirmed denial + rotate-changes-hash — accepted.

data_architecture.rationale: single owned() chokepoint over per-tenant buckets; opaque random key ids; sha256-only secret representation; no shared id namespace; tenant-scoped list/audit/erase re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green — accepted.

devex.rationale: npm test = node --test glob; ops/ci.sh drives the suite; chaos.sh + rollback.sh --check are real drills; seed-audit.mjs refreshes the audit marker re-read against running evidence: 38/38 green — accepted.
